parameters.query:
-- Triage requests not yet posted, what was already posted for each, why the
-- gate kept triage back, and when W3 may ask the gate about posting again.
SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
         'nightly_run_id', t.nightly_run_id::text, 'state', t.state, 'posted', t.posted,
         'dispatched_at', to_char(t.dispatched_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
         'created_at', to_char(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
         'queue_reason', (SELECT d.reason FROM audit.deferred_requests d WHERE d.action = 'dispatch' AND d.workflow = 'triage'
                            AND d.target = t.nightly_run_id::text AND d.done_at IS NULL LIMIT 1),
         'post_wait_until', (SELECT to_char(d.not_before AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') FROM audit.deferred_requests d
                               WHERE d.action = 'triage-post' AND d.target = t.nightly_run_id::text AND d.done_at IS NULL LIMIT 1)
       ) ORDER BY t.nightly_run_id), '[]') AS requests
FROM audit.triage_requests t WHERE t.state IN ('dispatched', 'deferred');

parameters.query:
-- Remember the message for this night, and map a posted failure message.
WITH remembered AS (
  UPDATE audit.triage_requests SET posted = posted || to_jsonb($2::text), updated_at = now()
  WHERE nightly_run_id = $1::bigint AND NOT posted ? $2
  RETURNING nightly_run_id
), mapped AS (
  INSERT INTO audit.message_map (channel, ts, kind, test_id, nightly_run_id, class, thread_ts)
  SELECT $3, $4, 'failure', $5, $1::bigint, $6, $7 WHERE $4 <> '' AND $5 <> ''
  ON CONFLICT (channel, ts) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM remembered) AS remembered, (SELECT count(*) FROM mapped) AS mapped;

-- The night is posted (classified) or fell back; the gate's posting request is done.
WITH saved AS (
  UPDATE audit.triage_requests
  SET state = CASE WHEN $2 = 'classified' THEN 'posted' ELSE 'fallback' END,
      triage_run_id = coalesce(nullif($3, '')::bigint, triage_run_id), reason = $4, updated_at = now()
  WHERE nightly_run_id = $1::bigint
  RETURNING nightly_run_id
), dequeued AS (
  UPDATE audit.deferred_requests SET done_at = now()
  WHERE action = 'triage-post' AND target = $1 AND done_at IS NULL
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM saved) AS saved;
